disposition_reason: Table 3 prints pooled summary statistics for 20 metals in Ugandan spirits; the text prints copper per local spirit and the reference Scotch whisky.

study.design: market survey with health risk assessment
study.origin: sachet spirits blended and packaged in Kampala, Uganda; locally distilled spirits from Bolo, Awere, Teso Bar (Lira) and Nsambya (Kampala); reference Scotch whisky from Scotland
study.market: sachets purchased in Acoli, northern Uganda (first-encounter basis, not random); reference whisky purchased in San Diego, USA

period.as_reported: not reported (one brand sampled twice one year apart)

study.method: 20 mL refluxed with nitric and hydrochloric acid at 93 C for 2 h, ICP-MS (Thermo X-Series 2, standard and CCT-KED modes)
lod: detection limits given in S1 Table (not available)
study.qa: second-source standards every 10 samples; duplicates; ethanol/water blanks and laboratory control spiked duplicates; tube leaching blank; no CRM in spirit matrix
